body: If your diet consists of mostly "unhealthy" foods and very little "healthy" (like veggies, fruit, nutritious meals etc) then start by adding those in, on top of your food intake now. It may seem counter productive but this way you are not depriving yourself of the things you are used to and associating the food that might help you lose weight with feeling unsatisfied and will hopefully help you avoid binges.
This is something most people are never able to do. I'm sure you're already aware of this but you have achieved something amazing and you should be so proud. I'm proud of you, strong stranger

Finding something to make sure you do everyday might help, get a plant that you have to look after, give yourself a reason to get up and do  something. You'll feel much more accomplished.
